```sql
SELECT p."ID", p."SEX", DATE_TRUNC('year', p."Birthday") AS "Birthday_masked", SPLIT_PART(p."Diagnosis", ' ', 1) AS "Diagnosis_masked", COUNT(*) AS abnormal_lab_count
FROM main."Laboratory" l
JOIN main."Patient" p ON l."ID" = p."ID"
WHERE l."GOT" >= 60
  AND l."Date" >= '1997-01-01'
  AND l."Date" < '1998-01-01'
GROUP BY p."ID", p."SEX", DATE_TRUNC('year', p."Birthday"), SPLIT_PART(p."Diagnosis", ' ', 1)
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10
ORDER BY p."ID";
```
